name: Fellowshipping
overview: Fellowshipping, as taught in Scripture, involves a committed and active participation in the life of the believer that honors God by presenting ourselves as living sacrifices and engaging in mutual encouragement. Romans 12:1 calls believers to offer their bodies as holy and acceptable service to God, which undergirds the communal aspect of fellowship. Colossians 3:16 emphasizes the importance of Christ’s word dwelling richly among believers, fostering teaching and admonishing through worship and spiritual songs. Hebrews 10:25 exhorts believers not to neglect gathering together but to encourage one another, especially as the day of Christ’s return approaches, highlighting the necessity of regular assembly and mutual support within the body of Christ.
